label: Solana Prediction Markets
summary: This cluster consists of decentralized platforms built on the Solana blockchain that enable users to bet on future events, memecoin performance, and continuous probability distributions.

representativeProjects.name: SAGA Prediction Market
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A decentralized prediction market on Solana using an AMM to trade conditional tokens for any event.

representativeProjects.name: Knostra
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A gamified prediction market platform designed for consumer engagement and social betting.

representativeProjects.name: Spulse
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A decentralized prediction market on Solana using Blinks for social media-based poll creation and staking.

representativeProjects.name: Bet on Pump
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A gamified prediction market for memecoin price movements featuring SocialFi and iGaming elements.

representativeProjects.name: Oracle’s Edge: Solana based Distribution Prediction market
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Solana-based distribution prediction market using continuous probability curves for non-binary outcome trading.
